title: euphorbia ritchiei subsp. marsabitensis
intro: Euphorbia ritchiei subsp. marsabitensis, commonly known as Marsabit Spurge, is a succulent plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is traditionally used in East African folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, wounds, and gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Marsabit Spurge include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and cardenolides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities.
